summary: Corebridge Financial filed an 8-K reporting stockholder vote results from its July 30, 2026 special meeting. Stockholders approved the merger agreement with Equitable Holdings, along with an advisory compensation proposal and an ESPP plan. The merger proposal passed with 366,176,877 votes for, 119,470 against, and 494,943 abstentions, representing 82.28% of outstanding shares present. The transaction, announced March 26, 2026, involves Equitable and newly formed subsidiaries, effectively a going-private/reorganization. No deal terms were disclosed in this filing. Watch for closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
